_meta.space: asset stored space (Y-up); apply to the original mesh to get the variant
_meta.apply: v = matrix @ p + translation, translation [0,0,0] when absent; matrix is authoritative, mirror_x plus rotation_euler_deg (XYZ, degrees) is the same thing decomposed as mirror-in-X then rotate
_meta.reproducible: true when the transform recreates the variant from the original, so the variant mesh need not be kept; false when the variant is a different mesh
_meta.suffix_relation: how part.py relates this id to the one it is recreated from: an id-substitution rule, not a claim about the mesh - _NE/_NW pairs are a mirrored mesh, _N/_S pairs are a 180 degree rotation
